title: A Piece of Home
description: Kai quietly admits that he'd like to recover a Choso plush from a world he remembers.
completion_text: Kai has something that reminds him of his old world. He trusts you with that part of his past.

stages.title: A Piece of Home
stages.lead: Find the Choso plush and show it to Kai while holding it.
notes: A personal request from Kai. The quest is only offered through their friendship dialogue.

objectives.description: Show Kai the Choso plush (hold it while speaking to him).
